description: Render GeoJSON as Cesium primitives for large browser datasets. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

allowPicking.description: Allow picking (default true, disable for better performance)

flyTo.description: Fly to the loaded geometry (default true)

pickMetadata.description: Additional pick metadata set before first render; locked afterwards

resourceId.description: Stored GeoJSON resource ID (mutually exclusive with data or url)

sessionId.description: Target browser session ID for multi-browser routing (optional)

url.description: GeoJSON file URL (mutually exclusive with data)

name: addGeoJsonPrimitive
